name: Mombo Combo Legacy
storyline:
Get ready for an epic journey through the vibrant universe of Mombo Combo Legacy — a fast-paced platformer packed with action and adventure! Defeat monstrous enemies and take on wild challenges to pull off incredible combos. Unlock powerful forms and unleash your MOMBASTIC abilities to explore unforgettable worlds!

• MASTER INSANE COMBOS ACROSS HUNDREDS OF LEVELS!
Journey through epic worlds, each filled with dangerous enemies and tricky obstacles. Complete unique challenges in every stage to trigger a MOMBO COMBO! How high can you score on each level?

• UNLOCK POWERFUL NEW FORMS!
Transform Mombo to reach impossible heights and break speed limits! Each form comes with special abilities you can unlock to customize your playstyle. Get ready to take your combos to absolutely insane levels!

• STYLE YOUR MOMBO WITH AWESOME SKINS!
Collect fabulous skins and combo your way through the world in style! Choose a unique look for each form and swap whenever you like. Each skin is cooler than the last!

• COLLECT AND EVOLVE YOUR PETS!
Find Orumons to join you on your adventure! Each one boosts you in a different way. Evolve them to become stronger and mix and match your Orumon team to create unbeatable strategies!

• TAKE DOWN MONSTROUS BOSSES!
Think you’ve got what it takes to crush the most terrifying bosses around? The world is counting on the prophesized hero once again. Show them who’s the boss with skill, courage… and a whole lot of tongue!
summary: Mombo Combo Legacy is a fast-paced platformer packed with action and adventure! Battle monstrous enemies, unlock powerful forms, and pull off incredible combos across hundreds of handcrafted levels. Customize your Mombo with stylish skins, collect and evolve Orumon pets, and take down epic bosses in your quest to save the universe. Easy to play, hard to master — and all powered by skill, courage… and a whole lot of tongue.
